scope: source-order outline, attached field guidance and reviewed token-preserving JSON layout
checks: one small BOM/CRLF resource formats/compacts without changing member order, escaped key/string tokens, exact Java-long and decimal tokens; explicit container newlines preserve outer trivia
outline visits actual source-order values, supports subtree/type/path-excerpt filters and escaped pointers, refuses duplicate/oversized parsed metadata and leaves unknown values intact
schema and controlled native-inventory guidance stay separate, retain exact numeric metadata and bounded snippets, and do not insert defaults
controlled formatting dialog requires a preview for current options, downloads exact proposed text, makes one explicit commit and refuses changed schema ownership
controlled outline/guidance dialog filters, downloads exact selected raw tokens, reveals the captured source span, clears invalid-filter results and refuses read-only editing

actual application formatting adds one undo entry, keeps original tokens through undo, schedules a recovery draft, cancels obsolete preview work and does not generate; ordinary edits retain existing generation behavior
limits: One small source, authored schema/inventory metadata and controlled Node modal/application hosts. Formatting admits 2 MiB / 32,768 values, output 8 MiB; outline admits 32,768 values, 4,096 rows, 1 Mi metadata units and 4 Mi inspected units.
